messages:
Maya (PM): Quick mid-Q OKR check — can we call out what shipped vs slipped for the runtime-v3 milestone? TL;DR: need owners for rollback plan. @dev:ryan @Lina (Eng)

dev:ryan: Shipping notes: can confirm model routing canary went to prod at 20% last night. Latency looks stable so far. :thumbsup:

Lina (Eng): We rolled the autoscale bump but hit intermittent allocation failures overnight, which blocked Dedicated pool rollout. Slipped ~3 days on that piece.

Sam (Eng-Infra): Looking at the logs now — seeing sporadic OOMs on the node group during KV cache warmup. Reopening sizing ticket and will run a capacity pass. PR/diag: https://in.reddit/infra/pr/123 (placeholder)

Maya (PM): OK — proposed owners: @Lina own infra follow-up and fix, @dev:ryan own canary monitoring + rollback play, @Sam run capacity soak. Can you confirm owners & ETAs?

Lina (Eng): I’ll take infra. ETA: validate fix and smoke test by EOD tomorrow. I’ll also add a regression test to the CI matrix to catch warmup OOMs.

dev:ryan: I’ll add a rollback alert and quick dashboard tiles in the Console today — plan: if p95 latency > 150ms for 5m or error-rate > 1% -> trigger auto-fallback to v2 variant.

OpsBot: Deploy v3-canary started by devops at 14:03 UTC. Status: partial success (20% traffic).

Maya (PM): Next steps (short):
1) Lina validate infra fix (EOD tomorrow)
2) Ryan implement rollback alert (today)
3) Sam run soak/capacity test (in progress)
Please post blockers here.

Sam (Eng-Infra): Starting a 1h soak test now (traffic pattern A). Will post results and heap traces if failures reproduce.

Lina (Eng): One request from eng — can product freeze non-critical schema migrations until this rollout is stable? Minimizes churn while we validate.

Maya (PM): Yes — freezing non-critical schema changes for 48h. I’ll update the rollout doc: https://go/redwood/okr/runtime-v3-rollout

dev:ryan: Also, quick CR ask: can reviewers prioritize PR #452 (autoscale fix)? It’s small but unblocked.

Lina (Eng): Pinging @Ben (Eng) on reviews — thanks. :pray:

Ben (Eng): Reviewing now, expect comments in ~30m.

Maya (PM): Great. I’ll update the OKR board after fixes land and mark the autoscale subtask as "in validation". Tagging for weekly sync tomorrow — thanks everyone. :rocket:
